report.description: Path to the inspection-report@1 markdown. Must pass tools/inspect-lint.mjs before any finding is read.

target.description: Working tree to change. Must match the report's target and ref, or the session halts (HRD-IN-3).

start_at.description: Override the report's named next action. Requires an explicit operator instruction.

commits.description: Commit locally per finding. Pushing is never permitted regardless (HRD-SAFE-3).

include_deferred.description: Allow findings whose timeline class is never worked automatically. Requires naming the finding.
